battle.name: 黎陽之戰
battle.brief: 618年（隋大業十四年、唐武德元年）六月，宇文化及率驍果禁軍十萬自江都北還，圍瓦崗軍徐世勣所守的黎陽倉城，李密親率二萬步騎迎敵，斷其歸路而假意通糧，於童山苦戰一日，終迫其糧盡眾叛、王軌獻東郡。卡面亞述長弓屬公元前七世紀的亞述裝備，相距一千三百餘年，並不在此戰現場。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋朝末年瓦崗軍與隋朝鎮軍在河南黎陽一線的決定性交鋒，時間在大業十四年、皇泰元年、唐武德元年（618）交替之際，交戰地點在黎陽縣與其西側的黎陽倉城一帶，東臨黃河北岸，西接衛州、浚縣，控扼南北漕運與驛道要衝。瓦崗軍一方是李密整合的河南武裝，統轄步卒、騎兵與沿黃河的水師，旗下以李密為核心，配有徐世勣、秦叔寶等宿將；名義上則受洛陽皇泰主楊侗頒授太尉、尚書令、東南道大行台行軍元帥、魏公等號，是當時唯一能以朝廷名分號召討逆的軍隊。隋軍一方是宇文化及所率的江都禁軍與驍果軍，約十萬之眾，由煬帝近侍武將直接統率，奉江都朝廷之命北還洛陽；部將陳智略、張童兒分領一軍，刑部尚書王軌奉命留守東郡、保管輜重糧秣。河北的竇建德此時另建政權、控制河北諸郡，是與李密、宇文化及並列的第三方勢力，雖然沒有直接投入黎陽會戰，卻讓中原形成三方競逐的格局，也讓宇文化及不敢在黎陽久拖。
countriesEn: This war was a decisive clash between the Wagang Army and the Sui government's field force at Liyang in southern Henan, fought in the year in which the Daye, Huangtai and Wude eras overlapped (618). The fighting area lay around the county of Liyang and the Liyang granary complex just to its west, on the north bank of the Yellow River; to the west stood the prefectures of Weizhou and Xun, and whoever held this ground controlled the ferries, the dyke road and the grain traffic between north and south. The Wagang side was the armed force that Li Mi had welded together in Henan, combining foot soldiers, cavalry and river flotillas along the Yellow River, with Li Mi at its centre and veteran commanders such as Xu Shiji and Qin Qiong under him. Officially it marched under titles conferred by Yang Tong, the Huangtai ruler at Luoyang — Grand Commandant, President of the Ministry of Works, Chief Military Governor of the Southeast Circuit and Duke of Wei — which made it the only army in the empire able to call itself to arms with the court's own mandate. The Sui side was the Jiangdu palace guard and the Xiaoguo elite guard under Yu Wenhuaji, some 100,000 strong, commanded by a former close attendant of Emperor Yang and marching north by order of the Jiangdu court with the intention of returning to Luoyang; his subordinates Chen Zhilue and Zhang Tong'er each led a detachment, and the Ministry of Justice commissioner Wang Gui was left behind at Dongjun to guard the baggage and the grain. In the north, Dou Jiande had founded a state of his own and held the prefectures of Hebei, making him the third power alongside Li Mi and Yu Wenhuaji; although he committed no troops to Liyang, his presence turned the central plain into a three-way contest and made it impossible for Yu Wenhuaji to linger at Liyang.
people: 本役的決定性人物是李密。他是關中李氏後人，隋初曾任宮中書侍郎，因家世與才學受到朝中側目，後起兵於河南瓦崗，逐步收攏周北地區的散兵與饑民，勢力直抵黎陽。618年他以魏公身份集結二萬步騎北上，對宇文化及的十萬大軍一律不用正面硬撼：先令徐世勣固守黎陽倉城，把對手釘在城下，再以封鎖歸路、假意通糧的方式消耗其糧秣與士氣。徐世勣為瓦崗軍的另一根支柱，原是地方團練出身，與李密交厚，領兵在黎陽拒守，屢挫化及攻勢，使倉城始終不失。李密麾下的秦叔寶在童山之戰中衝鋒陷陣；李密中流矢墜馬、人事不省之際，正是他殺入陣中救主，把李密扶回本陣。全場最關鍵的倒戈者是隋吏王軌與化及部將陳智略、張童兒：三人都在大局已去時率部或獻城歸降，使化及軍心崩潰。另一端的宇文化及出身宿衛，殺隋煬帝後挾眾北還，他在黎陽求糧於李密而不得，又發現所部不受自己控制，盛怒之下強逼部下背水一戰，兩軍自晨至夜。
peopleEn: The decisive figure of the campaign was Li Mi, a descendant of the Li clan of Guanzhong who had served as a palace secretary under the Sui and whose family background and learning had already made the court suspicious of him. He raised men at Wagang in Henan, drew in scattered soldiers and famine-stricken villagers from the Zhoubei district, and by 618 his authority reached the granary at Liyang. Operating as Duke of Wei he massed 20,000 foot and horse against Yu Wenhuaji's host of 100,000, and refused a general engagement at every stage: first he ordered Xu Shiji to hold the Liyang granary and pin the enemy against the walls, then he sealed the roads of retreat and the supply line and pretended to negotiate a delivery of grain, so as to exhaust the invader's food and morale. Xu Shiji was the second pillar of the Wagang Army, a former local militia leader and a close friend of Li Mi who commanded the defence of Liyang, turned back assault after assault, and never lost the granary. Qin Qiong, one of Li Mi's commanders, was in the thick of the fighting at Tongshan; when a stray arrow struck Li Mi's horse and he lay unconscious, it was Qin Qiong who cut into the melee and carried him back to his own ranks. The most consequential defections came from the Sui commissioner Wang Gui and from Yu Wenhuaji's own generals Chen Zhilue and Zhang Tong'er, all of whom came over with their men or their city once the battle was lost, and it was they who broke the heart of the invading army. On the other side, Yu Wenhuaji was by background a palace guard officer; after killing Emperor Yang he marched north with the army in his hands, begged Li Mi for grain at Liyang, found that his own men would not accept his authority over their rations, and in anger forced the fight at Tongshan from dawn until nightfall.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓是公元前七世紀亞述王國的弓兵裝備，弓兵在戰車上發矢，與投石機、鐵矛和厚實的盾配合，用來壓制城頭、守住渡口，或在攻城之前先行削弱敵陣。它距本役一千三百餘年，屬於兩河流域弓兵傳統的另一個時期，與618年的河南戰場並無直接承襲關係，因此不應被當作本役的實配兵器來讀。本役中真正上陣的遠射手分屬兩方：瓦崗軍以木弓、桑弓為主，步軍以齊射壓制城頭與拒馬，騎兵用弓箭配合馬槊作戰，箭鏃多為鐵製或骨製；隋軍驍果禁軍除弓箭外，還配蹶張弩與臂弩一類的單兵弩機，用來在陣前抑制對方的衝鋒，攻城時則列雲梯、撞車與投石機。步戰主力仍是槊、矛與環首刀、長刀，騎兵另備馬刀，護具以皮甲、札甲與兜鍪為主，拒馬槊與大盾則用來護住行軍縱隊和糧車。瓦崗軍久處河南水網地帶，舟船是運糧與沿河設防的重要工具，而黎陽倉與東郡的存糧，實為本役後勤的核心。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card is the archer's equipment of the Assyrian kingdom of the seventh century BC. Those archers shot from war wagons in cooperation with stone-throwers, iron spears and stout shields, in order to blanket a city wall, hold a crossing, or soften a defended position before an assault. The weapon predates this battle by more than thirteen centuries and belongs to a different phase of the river-valley archery tradition, with no direct line of descent to the Henan battlefield of 618, so it should not be read as equipment actually present on the field at Liyang. What the two sides really used were the missiles of their own age. The Wagang troops carried wooden and mulberry bows: the foot loosed volleys against walls and against the caltrops and barricades in front of them, while their cavalry combined the bow with the mao-spear, using arrows with iron or bone heads. Yu Wenhuaji's Xiaoguo guards, besides the bow, were issued powerful single-shot crossbows of the leg-drawn and arm-rest types to check enemy charges in the open, and against the walls they brought scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwers. Close combat still turned on the mao-spear, the lance, the ring-pommel sword and the straight sword, with sabres for the cavalry; protection consisted of leather and lamellar armour with iron helmets, and the long mao-spear and large shields screened marching columns and grain carts. Because the Wagang base lay in the watery country of the Yellow River, boats mattered for moving grain and holding river lines, and the stores in the Liyang granary and at Dongjun were the true logistical core of the campaign.
tactics: 宇文化及的戰法是典型的驍果禁軍式速決：十萬眾自江都沿運河北上，直趨黎陽，企圖以兵鋒與糧道一舉碾平瓦崗，並趕在洛陽方向失控之前奪回中樞。他先分兵圍困徐世勣守的黎陽倉城，自率主力南下會戰，卻在此落入李密布好的節奏。李密深知對方遠來師老、糧秣不繼，於是避開正面硬撼，改以三手爭時間：派兵封鎖化及的退路與糧道，使黎陽倉成為吃住他的口袋；一面派使議和，佯允輸糧，讓化及放鬆對本部糧秣配給的管制；一面令徐世勣固守待援，把攻城戰拖成消耗戰。化及察覺受騙，怒而列陣於衛州童山，逼李密速戰，兩軍自晨至夜反覆衝撞，李密中流矢墜馬，部軍一度動搖，幸賴秦叔寶救主退回汲縣才穩住陣腳。此夜之後化及糧道已絕，部眾相率夜奔，陳智略、張童兒各引所部來降；王軌也在東郡看清形勢，開城獻出輜重。瓦崗軍全勝不在兵力，而在於把對手的糧道、士氣與指揮鏈逐一拆開。
tacticsEn: Yu Wenhuaji's plan was the classic fast decision of the Xiaoguo guard: he marched the 100,000 up from Jiangdu along the transport route, drove straight at Liyang, and hoped to crush the Wagang in a single stroke while the situation at Luoyang was still slipping out of his control. He split off troops to invest the granary held by Xu Shiji, marched his main body south to meet Li Mi, and there walked into the rhythm Li Mi had prepared for him. Knowing that the enemy was worn out by a long march and short of provisions, Li Mi avoided a general engagement and instead fought for time with three moves. He sent troops to seal the enemy's line of retreat and supply, so that the granary became a pocket that held the invader fast; he sent envoys to talk peace and pretended to agree to deliver grain, so that Yu Wenhuaji would relax his control over the distribution of rations; and he kept Xu Shiji within the walls to wait, turning the siege into a war of attrition. Realising he had been tricked, Yu Wenhuaji angrily deployed at Tongshan in Weizhou and demanded a quick decision, and the two armies collided again and again from morning to nightfall. A stray arrow struck Li Mi, he fell from his horse, and his formation wavered until Qin Qiong brought him out and the army fell back to Jixian to steady itself. After that night the enemy's supply route was gone, the men drifted away, and Chen Zhilue and Zhang Tong'er came over each with his command; at Dongjun, Wang Gui read the situation and opened the city with the stores he guarded. Wagang's complete victory did not come from numbers, but from taking the enemy's food, spirit and chain of command apart piece by piece.
data: 本役可考的數字有數處：618年六月，宇文化及自江都帶兵十萬北還，自江都至黎陽行程一千三百餘里，途中所賴全在東郡的輜重與沿途州縣的接濟。李密以二萬步騎赴黎陽迎敵，兵力不到對方四分之一，兵器的數量與質量都落在下風。徐世勣被圍在黎陽倉城，防守延續數日，屢攻不下。童山列陣在黎陽西南數十里、浚縣西南一帶，兩軍自晨至夜一日而未分勝負。化及放棄黎陽後北趨魏縣，方向在今河北大名縣西南，與魏縣之間尚有數百里，中途糧盡人散。李密的收穫是可計的：陳智略、張童兒兩部來降，王軌獻出東郡及其所守輜重，李密由此得到河南北部的倉廩與渡口。此役之後瓦崗軍入洛陽、隋室僅存名號，而北方實際掌權者只剩下李密、竇建德與王世充三方；李密在河南握有的兵眾與糧秣，此時已足以支撐一次大規模用兵。
dataEn: A few figures from this campaign can be stated. In June 618 Yu Wenhuaji led 100,000 men north from Jiangdu, a march of more than 1,300 li from Jiangdu to Liyang, and depended for the whole way on the baggage at Dongjun and on the prefectures along the route for supply. Li Mi brought 20,000 foot and horse to meet him — fewer than a quarter of the enemy in strength, and inferior in both the quantity and the quality of his weapons. Xu Shiji was shut up in the Liyang granary, and the defence lasted several days, with repeated assaults failing. The line at Tongshan lay several tens of li south-west of Liyang, in the country south-west of Xun, and the two armies fought from dawn until dusk without a decision. After abandoning the siege, Yu Wenhuaji turned north towards Weixian, in modern southern Daming in Hebei, several hundred li away, and his troops scattered en route for want of food. What Li Mi could count were men and stores: the two commands of Chen Zhilue and Zhang Tong'er came over, and Wang Gui handed over Dongjun with the baggage he was guarding, giving Li Mi the granaries and fords of northern Henan. After this battle the Wagang Army entered Luoyang and the Sui court survived in name only, while in the north just three powers actually held authority — Li Mi, Dou Jiande and Wang Shichong; the troops and stores Li Mi now held in Henan were by themselves enough to support a large-scale campaign.
cause: 黎陽之戰的起因，是隋朝在江都與洛陽兩地同時崩解。618年三月，隋煬帝在江都被宇文化及所殺，禁軍隨即裹著新主北上還都，名義上要平定叛亂、重立朝廷，實際上是宇文化及企圖用手裡十萬驍果與禁軍換取洛陽的政權。同一時候，瓦崗軍已由李密經營成河南最大的武裝集團，控有黎陽倉與東郡一線的糧道與渡口，與宇文化及的前進路線正面重疊。洛陽的越王楊侗在皇泰元年即位之後，只能向各方授職以自保，給李密加太尉、尚書令、東南道大行台行軍元帥、魏公，命令他先平宇文化及、再入朝輔政，等於把消滅隋室最後武裝的任務正式交到李密手上。於是此役已不是兩支地方叛軍的爭鬥，而是李密奉朝廷名分討逆、宇文化及挾禁軍自還而拒詔，兩邊的正面對撞。化及遠來師疲，糧道又握在李密手中，向強求糧不成、士卒不聽節制，遂在盛怒中接受李密的假和，兩軍才在童山被迫決戰。
causeEn: The cause of the battle was the simultaneous disintegration of the Sui state at Jiangdu and at Luoyang. In March 618 Emperor Yang was killed at Jiangdu by Yu Wenhuaji, and the guard marched north at once with the new ruler in tow, nominally to put down the rebellions and re-establish the court, but in fact to exchange the 100,000 Xiaoguo and palace troops in his hands for the government at Luoyang. At the same time the Wagang Army had become, under Li Mi, the largest armed group in Henan, holding the granary line and the crossings at Liyang and Dongjun — exactly the ground over which Yu Wenhuaji's advance would have to run. Yang Tong, Prince of Yue, who had taken the throne at Luoyang in the first year of Huangtai, could only distribute titles among the competing powers to keep himself in place: Li Mi was made Grand Commandant, President of the Ministry of Works, Chief Military Governor of the Southeast Circuit and Duke of Wei, and was ordered to destroy Yu Wenhuaji first and then enter the capital to assist the court, which handed him the task of finishing off the last armed force of the Sui. The quarrel was therefore no longer a clash between two local rebellions: on one side stood Li Mi acting under a commission from the court to punish the usurper, on the other a Yu Wenhuaji who carried the palace troops back north and refused the edict. Worn out by the march, and starved on a supply line held in Li Mi's hands, Yu Wenhuaji found that his requests for grain went unanswered and that his men would not accept his authority over their rations, so he swallowed Li Mi's false peace in anger, and only then did the two armies come to a real decision at Tongshan.
impact: 這場戰役的後果，超出一次會戰的份量。它拆掉了隋朝最後一支能作戰的中央武力：江都禁軍與驍果經此役消耗與叛散，隋朝在中原再無成建制的師團，李密則趁勢入洛陽，迎皇泰主楊侗入宮居中，隋室自此只剩名號。同時它改變了北方戰略的格局，瓦崗軍由地方叛軍一躍成為受朝廷名分節制的武裝，李密得以挾大義名分整合河南郡縣；瓦崗系的將領如秦叔寶等人，其後陸續歸唐，成為唐軍骨幹之一，而竇建德在河北趁隙坐大，與王世充、李密形成三角。從長遠看，618年的黎陽是隋唐易代的真正起點：此後的洛陽之變、李密北伐與虎牢之戰，都是這次勝利的直接延伸；唐初編纂的《資治通鑑》把此役列為唐紀之始，說明在正統觀點裡，此役之後才輪到李唐收拾殘局；秦叔寶等瓦崗舊將其後陸續歸唐，使唐室的騎兵突擊帶上瓦崗的底子，而竇建德在河北坐大，又決定了唐室先取河北、再圖關中的次序。
impactEn: The consequences of this battle reached far beyond the field itself. It dismantled the last central military force the Sui still had: the Jiangdu guard and the Xiaoguo were spent and scattered by the campaign, and the dynasty no longer possessed a formed field army in the central plain, while Li Mi marched into Luoyang and brought the Huangtai ruler Yang Tong into the palace, leaving the Sui with nothing but a name. It also changed the strategic shape of the north. The Wagang Army, once a local rebellion, became an armed force holding a legitimate mandate, and Li Mi was able to bring the prefectures of Henan under one authority behind the banner of a righteous cause; Wagang commanders such as Qin Qiong later entered Tang service and formed part of its military backbone, while Dou Jiande expanded in Hebei on the strength of the opening, forming a triangle with Wang Shichong and Li Mi. In the long run, Liyang in 618 is the real starting point of the Sui-Tang transition: the change of government at Luoyang, Li Mi's northern campaign and the battle of Hulao all follow directly from this victory. The Tang historians placed the campaign at the opening of the Annals of Tang, which says that in the orthodox view it was only after this battle that the Li Tang house had to pick up the pieces; Wagang veterans such as Qin Qiong later entered Tang service, giving the Tang cavalry a debt of the Wagang fighting method, while Dou Jiande's unopposed expansion in Hebei fixed the order in which the Tang house would take the north first and Guanzhong afterwards.
result: 結果是瓦崗軍以二萬對十萬的劣勢兵力，完成了對隋朝主力的一次阻擊戰。宇文化及沒有拿下黎陽倉，童山一日苦戰也未取得決定性勝果，反而因糧道被斷、部眾叛離而先行崩潰；陳智略、張童兒相繼率部降李密，刑部尚書王軌獻出東郡及所守輜重，隋軍的糧秣與重裝落入了瓦崗軍手中。化及收拾殘兵向北退走，方向指向魏縣，這條路上再沒有可依託的城池與糧站，其部眾沿途星散，最終在翌年被竇建德部所擒，這支隋軍至此在北方完全瓦解。李密則乘勝入洛陽，其後與王世充爭衡失利，北走；竇建德又於虎牢被李世民生擒，隋末殘餘勢力盡歸李唐。此役之後瓦崗軍在河南聲勢大盛，據《資治通鑑》記其眾至數十萬、號四十萬，地方郡縣多歸響應；黎陽一戰是整條統一道路上的第一塊骨牌。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Wagang Army, with 20,000 men against 100,000, completed a delaying victory over the main Sui army. Yu Wenhuaji never took the Liyang granary, and the day of hard fighting at Tongshan brought him no decisive success; on the contrary his supply was cut and his men deserted, and Chen Zhilue and Zhang Tong'er came over to Li Mi with their commands, while the Ministry of Justice commissioner Wang Gui handed over Dongjun and the stores he was guarding, so that the Sui army's grain and heavy equipment fell into Wagang hands. Yu Wenhuaji gathered what was left and turned north towards Weixian, a road on which no city and no supply station remained to lean on, and his ranks thinned along the way until the force was taken the following year by Dou Jiande's troops; with that, the Sui army was completely broken in the north. Li Mi entered Luoyang in the winner's place and, though he later lost ground to Wang Shichong and withdrew north, Dou Jiande in turn was taken alive by Li Shimin at Hulao, after which the last Sui forces passed entirely to the Li Tang house. After the battle the Wagang Army's strength in Henan swelled, the Zizhi Tongjian recording that it numbered several tens of thousands of men, proclaimed as forty thousand, with the prefectures of the region answering to it in droves; the battle at Liyang was the first domino of the whole road to unification.
